method: Exact Ghidra Listing flow traversal of a caller-selected address range; direct jumps and fallthrough traversed, call bodies excluded. Optional seeds come from every original dword in an independently retained complete jump-table read. Existing exact-address requests may be resumed without restarting the provider or rewriting evidence. Original per-instruction Evidence references retained. No synthetic procedure identity, binary annotation or process execution.
